source_refs.note: Exercise 6.5 (book p. 210), Question 9; answer key PDF 308 (book p. 306).

blocks.prompt: 9. Find equations of the tangent and normal to the hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) at the point \((a\sec\theta, b\tan\theta)\).
blocks.explanation:
Diya hua point \((a\sec\theta, b\tan\theta)\) hyperbola ka parametric point hai, yani curve ka koi bhi point is shakal mein likha ja sakta hai.
Example 27 mein humne kisi bhi point \((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent aur normal ke formulas nikale the.
Bas \(x_1 = a\sec\theta\), \(y_1 = b\tan\theta\) rakh kar saada karna hai.
Normal mein fractions khatam karne ke liye \(\sec\theta\tan\theta\) se multiply karenge.
Yeh sawal dikhata hai ke parametric form kitna kaam ka hai: ek hi \(\theta\) se poori curve ka har point mil jata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) aur \(P(a\sec\theta, b\tan\theta)\).
Maloom karna: \(P\) par tangent aur normal.
Tareeqa: tangent \(\frac{xx_1}{a^2} - \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\) aur normal \(\frac{a^2x}{x_1} + \frac{b^2y}{y_1} = a^2 + b^2\) (Example 27).

\(P\) curve par hai
\[\dfrac{a^2\sec^2\theta}{a^2} - \dfrac{b^2\tan^2\theta}{b^2} = \sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = 1\]
Kyun: trigonometry ki identity \(\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = 1\). Formulas sirf curve ke point par lagte hain, is liye pehle yeh check zaroori hai.

Tangent
\[\dfrac{x \cdot a\sec\theta}{a^2} - \dfrac{y \cdot b\tan\theta}{b^2} = 1\]
\[\dfrac{x\sec\theta}{a} - \dfrac{y\tan\theta}{b} = 1\]
Kyun: \(x_1 = a\sec\theta\), \(y_1 = b\tan\theta\) rakha; upar neeche ek \(a\) aur ek \(b\) cancel ho gaya.

Normal
\[\dfrac{a^2x}{a\sec\theta} + \dfrac{b^2y}{b\tan\theta} = a^2 + b^2\]
\[\dfrac{ax}{\sec\theta} + \dfrac{by}{\tan\theta} = a^2 + b^2\]
Dono taraf \(\sec\theta\tan\theta\) se multiply:
\[ax\tan\theta + by\sec\theta = (a^2 + b^2)\sec\theta\tan\theta\]
Kyun: denominators khatam karne se kitab wali shakal milti hai (jab \(\tan\theta \ne 0\), yani vertices ke ilawa).
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{ax}{\sec\theta} \times \sec\theta\tan\theta = ax\tan\theta\); har term ko ehtiyat se multiply kijiye.

Tasdeeq:
\(P\) rakhein: tangent mein \(\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = 1\), sahi; normal mein \(a^2\sec\theta\tan\theta + b^2\tan\theta\sec\theta = (a^2 + b^2)\sec\theta\tan\theta\), sahi. Slopes \(\frac{b\sec\theta}{a\tan\theta}\) aur \(-\frac{a\tan\theta}{b\sec\theta}\) ka hasil-e-zarb \(-1\), yani perpendicular. Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
